option_relations.rationale: Chondroma is a benign cartilaginous tumor, but it is not directly related to the specific facial nerve hemangioma listed as a leaf.
Low-grade chondrosarcoma of the temporal bone is a malignant cartilaginous tumor, which is distinct from a facial nerve hemangioma.
Low-grade chondrosarcoma of the mastoid with facial nerve involvement is a malignant cartilaginous tumor, which is distinct from a facial nerve hemangioma.
Benign chondroma is a benign cartilaginous tumor, but it is not directly related to the specific facial nerve hemangioma listed as a leaf.
